title: Constrain untrusted input at trust boundaries
summary: Inputs from users, files, requests, queues, and integrations should be parsed and constrained before they influence application behavior.
review_checks: Check type, size, format, range, and allowed-value validation before sensitive use.
safe_tests: Use local malformed, boundary, and unexpected-type test inputs.
Confirm rejection is explicit and does not expose internals.
remediation: Use typed parsing and allowlists at the boundary.
Keep validation close to input handling and test failure paths.
